sunlight.title: Sunlight Analysis
sunlight.unavailable: No 3D building context available — sunlight analysis requires surrounding buildings.
sunlight.meaning.low: This building receives good direct sunlight year-round. Even in winter, the rooftop gets several hours of sun.
sunlight.meaning.medium: This building gets moderate direct sunlight. In winter, surrounding buildings may block sun for part of the day. Check window orientation during your viewing.
sunlight.meaning.high: This building gets very little direct sunlight in winter. Surrounding buildings significantly block the sun. Visit the property on a winter afternoon to assess natural light.
sunlight.meaning.unavailable: No 3D building context available — sunlight analysis requires surrounding buildings.
sunlight.viewingTip: Ask the seller: Which rooms get direct sunlight? Are there plans for new construction nearby that could block light?

risk.noise.title: Road Traffic Noise (Lden)
risk.noise.meaning.low: Road-traffic noise appears limited. Daily disturbance risk is relatively low.
risk.noise.meaning.medium: Road-traffic noise may be noticeable in daily use, especially with open windows.
risk.noise.meaning.high: Road-traffic noise is likely substantial and may affect sleep, comfort, and livability.
risk.noise.meaning.unavailable: Noise data could not be sampled for this location right now.
risk.noise.question: Ask/check at viewing: Can you close windows and still hear traffic? What are rush-hour noise levels in bedroom-facing rooms?
risk.noise.summary.good: Quiet area with low road-traffic noise.
risk.noise.summary.moderate: Some road noise noticeable, especially with windows open.
risk.noise.summary.poor: Significant traffic noise affecting daily comfort.
risk.noise.summary.critical: Very high road-traffic noise, likely affecting sleep and wellbeing.
risk.air.title: Air Quality (PM2.5 / NO2)
risk.air.meaning.low: Air-quality indicators are relatively favorable for this location.
risk.air.meaning.medium: Air-quality indicators suggest moderate exposure. Sensitive residents may notice effects.
risk.air.meaning.high: Air-quality indicators are elevated. Long-term exposure risk is meaningfully higher.
risk.air.meaning.unavailable: Air-quality data could not be sampled for this location right now.
risk.air.question: Ask/check at viewing: Are windows often kept closed due to traffic fumes? Is there mechanical ventilation with good filtration?
risk.air.summary.good: Air quality is favorable for this location.
risk.air.summary.moderate: Moderate air quality; sensitive individuals may be affected.
risk.air.summary.poor: Elevated air pollution levels; ventilation matters.
risk.air.summary.critical: Very poor air quality; significant health exposure risk.
risk.climate.title: Climate Stress (Heat / Water)
risk.climate.meaning.low: Climate-stress signals look limited for this location under sampled layers.
risk.climate.meaning.medium: Climate-stress signals suggest a moderate chance of heat or water nuisance.
risk.climate.meaning.high: Climate-stress signals indicate meaningful heat and/or water nuisance risk.
risk.climate.meaning.unavailable: Climate-stress data is not available for this address in the selected atlas layers.
risk.climate.question: Ask/check at viewing: Have there been heat or water issues in recent years? Which mitigation measures were installed by owner/VvE?
risk.climate.summary.good: Low climate stress; heat and water risk appear limited.
risk.climate.summary.moderate: Moderate chance of heat or water nuisance.
risk.climate.summary.poor: Significant heat and/or water stress risk.
risk.climate.summary.critical: Very high climate stress; heat and water nuisance likely.

risk.sunlight.summary.poor: Limited sunlight due to surrounding buildings.

warnings.foundation.title: Foundation Risk
warnings.foundation.high: Built in {{year}} on {{soil}} soil with {{rate}} mm/year subsidence. Pre-1970 buildings on soft soil are most affected. Repair costs typically range from EUR 60,000 to EUR 100,000+.
warnings.foundation.medium: Built in {{year}} on {{soil}} soil. Constructed during a transition period in foundation practices. The soft soil in this area warrants verification.
warnings.foundation.low: Built in {{year}} on {{soil}} soil. Modern foundation practices and stable soil conditions indicate low foundation risk.
warnings.foundation.unavailable: Foundation risk cannot be fully assessed — soil type data is unavailable for this location.
warnings.foundation.question_1: Has a foundation inspection (funderingsonderzoek) been performed? Request the report.
warnings.foundation.question_2: Look for visible signs: cracks near windows and doors, tilting walls, doors that stick, uneven floors.
warnings.foundation.question_3: If apartment: has the VvE discussed or budgeted for foundation repair?
warnings.foundation.question_4: Ask neighbors: have any buildings on this street had foundation work done?
warnings.foundation.source: Soil: PDOK BRO. Subsidence: Klimaateffectatlas. Construction year: BAG Kadaster.
warnings.foundation.disclaimer: This is an indicative assessment based on building age, soil type, and regional subsidence data. Only a professional funderingsonderzoek can determine actual condition.
warnings.erfpacht.title: Erfpacht (Ground Lease)
warnings.erfpacht.likely: {{municipality}} issues erfpacht for many properties. Verify the eigendomsstatus with the seller or via Kadaster.
warnings.erfpacht.question_2: If erfpacht: is it eeuwigdurend (perpetual) or tijdelijk (temporary)?
warnings.erfpacht.question_3: What is the current annual canon? When is the next canon review?
warnings.erfpacht.question_4: If temporary: when does the lease expire? What are the terms for renewal?
warnings.erfpacht.question_5: Has the canon recently been converted to eeuwigdurend? At what rate?
warnings.erfpacht.municipality_only_note: Detection is based on municipal land policy, not confirmed via Kadaster for this specific property.
warnings.erfpacht.source: Municipality: PDOK Locatieserver. Erfpacht prevalence based on municipal land policy.
warnings.erfpacht.disclaimer: Erfpacht status should be confirmed via the Kadaster register or the seller's notary deed.
warnings.vve.title: VvE (Owners' Association)
warnings.vve.description: This is an apartment ({{units}} units) with mandatory VvE membership. All owners share responsibility for maintenance, insurance, and communal areas.
warnings.vve.question_1: Request the VvE jaarrekening (annual financial report) — is the reserve fund healthy?
warnings.vve.question_2: Request the MJOP (meerjarenonderhoudsplan) — what large costs are planned?
warnings.vve.question_3: Request the notulen (minutes) of the last 3 VvE meetings.
warnings.vve.question_4: What is the monthly VvE bijdrage (contribution)?
warnings.vve.question_5: How many units are in the VvE? (Fewer units = higher per-unit costs)
warnings.vve.question_6: Is the building insured through the VvE? What does the policy cover?
warnings.asbestos.title: Asbestos Awareness
warnings.asbestos.description: Built in {{year}}, before the 1993 asbestos ban. Asbestos-containing materials may be present. Professional removal is legally required if materials are disturbed during renovation.
warnings.asbestos.question_1: Has an asbestos inventory (asbestinventarisatie) been conducted?
warnings.asbestos.question_2: Are there corrugated cement roof panels, vinyl floor tiles, or visible pipe insulation?
warnings.asbestos.question_3: If renovation is planned: has the seller disclosed potential asbestos-containing materials?
warnings.asbestos.question_4: Is there an asbestos-free certificate (asbestvrij verklaring)?
warnings.asbestos.source: Construction year: BAG Kadaster. Dutch asbestos ban: Asbestverwijderingsbesluit 2005.
warnings.asbestos.disclaimer: The presence of asbestos can only be confirmed by professional inspection.

soil.title: Soil Contamination Check
soil.description: Dutch law requires buyers to investigate soil contamination (onderzoeksplicht). Soil contamination can cost EUR 25,000-100,000+ to remediate.
soil.question_1: Has a soil investigation (bodemonderzoek) been conducted for this property?
soil.question_2: Are there underground storage tanks that have not been removed?
soil.question_3: If renovation is planned: will it disturb contaminated soil layers?
soil.disclaimer: Absence of a record does not guarantee clean soil. Only a professional bodemonderzoek can confirm soil condition.
soil.lead_pipe_note: Built in {{constructionYear}}, before 1960. Original water supply pipes may contain lead. If the property has a garden used by young children, or original pre-1960 water pipes, request a lead test (loodtest).
soil.lead_pipe_viewing_question: Does this property have original water pipes (pre-1960)? Has a lead test been conducted on soil or drinking water?
soil.lead_pipe_source: Construction year: BAG Kadaster. Lead pipe risk proxy based on Dutch water utility guidelines.
